title: IPGeolocation.io
description:
IPGeolocation.io enriches IPv4 and IPv6 observables with IP intelligence from one API request: geolocation, autonomous system, company, threat intelligence and abuse contact.

Key features:

- Threat score and VPN, proxy, residential proxy, Tor, relay, bot, spam and known attacker signals, turned into an OpenCTI score and labels
- Country and city with located-at relationships, autonomous system with belongs-to, operating organization and cloud provider
- Hostname with a resolves-to relationship
- Optional indicator for addresses whose risk score reaches a threshold
- A note with the full enrichment report, including the abuse contact
- TLP checked before any data leaves OpenCTI; works on free plans (location and ASN) and paid plans
short_description: Enriches IPv4 and IPv6 observables with geolocation, ASN, company, threat score, VPN, proxy and Tor signals, and abuse contacts from IPGeolocation.io.
